entries.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the exclusive identity reference. Preserve the subject’s exact facial features, hair, eyes, skin texture, age, and recognizable appearance.

Create an extraordinary 9:16 ultra-photorealistic cinematic fantasy masterpiece featuring an ENORMOUS vintage glass jar filling 90–95% of the frame, its curved transparent edges nearly touching the borders.

Inside the jar exists a breathtaking miniature universe. The subject sits comfortably cross-legged on glowing celestial clouds, smiling and gazing UP in wonder at a gigantic, spectacularly detailed full moon suspended above them.

Surround the subject with swirling galaxies, sparkling stars, liquid moonlight, cosmic mist, and dramatic ribbons of thick, sculptural acrylic paint.

WARDROBE: Creatively transform the subject’s outfit into something beautiful and cinematic that naturally complements their individual appearance, gender, age, and personal aesthetic.

ANATOMY — CRITICAL: Natural seated pose with exactly two legs, two clearly visible knees positioned left and right, two feet, two arms, and five fingers per hand. Legs folded naturally inward, hands resting near crossed ankles. Correct proportions and realistic joints. No extra knees, duplicated limbs, distorted fingers, or impossible anatomy.

ARTISTIC STYLE: Extreme 3D acrylic palette-knife textures, raised metallic gold and silver brushstrokes, midnight blues, rich teal, luminous ivory, subtle digital glitch fragments, realistic glass reflections, dramatic celestial lighting, and incredible depth.

COMPOSITION: Monumental jar dominating the frame, enormous glowing moon above, recognizable subject below looking upward. Magical, elegant, hyperrealistic, visually spectacular, and absolutely scroll-stopping.

9:16 vertical | No extra people | No distorted anatomy | No hands outside the jar | No text, logos, or watermarks.

entries.note: 需上传人物参考图，复刻镜前自拍姿势。
entries.prompt: Create a hyperrealistic, photorealistic mirror selfie that looks indistinguishable from an authentic smartphone photograph, preserving the subject’s identity, facial structure, skin tone, hair, body proportions, and likeness exactly as shown in the reference. Do not beautify, age, de-age, reshape, or alter the person. Reproduce the original pose accurately: an adult woman standing in front of a full-length mirror, facing the mirror with her face mostly concealed behind a smartphone held in one hand at eye level, long dark hair falling around her face and over her shoulders, one arm bent upward holding the phone, the other arm relaxed and bent near her waist, torso slightly angled, hips shifted to one side, one leg extended diagonally while the other supports her weight. Preserve the white off-the-shoulder long-sleeved cropped blouse with voluminous sleeves, exposed midriff and navel piercing, and the short white ruffled skirt exactly as seen in the reference. Maintain the vertical framing and mirror perspective: a bedroom or dressing area with a large wooden wardrobe and mirror on the left, a large plush teddy bear in the lower-left foreground, tiled floor, a dark window or glass door in the background, a chair, doorway, wall details, and several small cans or containers on the floor at the lower right. Keep the smartphone positioned in front of the face and retain the original concealed-face composition; do not invent visible facial features. Reproduce realistic monochrome black-and-white photography with natural tonal range, subtle sensor grain, accurate reflections, soft indoor overhead lighting, realistic shadows, authentic fabric folds and textures, natural skin texture, detailed hair strands, physically accurate perspective, and true-to-life proportions. The image must look like an unedited real mirror photograph taken with a modern phone camera, with no painting, illustration, CGI, 3D-rendered, anime, cartoon, stylized, glossy, surreal, or artificial appearance.

entries.author: edizkan_
entries.title: 街头偶遇的低画质抓拍感
entries.note: 原帖推荐用 ChatGPT 生成；需上传角色参考图。
entries.prompt:
Create a cinematic yet  low-quality candid street photograph of the uploaded reference character, captured from a distance on a quiet urban sidewalk against a large, plain, weathered concrete wall. Scene & Action: The character is doing something unexpectedly strange, funny, or fascinating in the street. Invent a unique, spontaneous activity that creates an interesting visual story. The moment feels completely accidental, like someone happened to witness something bizarre and quickly took a photo before it disappeared. Camera & Composition: Shot secretly from across the street using an old consumer camera with heavy digital zoom. The character occupies only 15–25% of the image, positioned off-center. Lots of empty wall and pavement surround the subject. Slightly awkward framing, imperfect horizon, occasional cropped pedestrians at the edges. The street feels mostly empty. Found Footage Quality (CRITICAL): The image must look like a degraded frame from a forgotten 2005 street video, captured on a cheap digital camcorder.

Strong analog-style grain
Slight motion blur and imperfect focus
Soft, smeared edges from excessive digital zoom
Faint chromatic bleeding and washed-out colors
Uneven exposure, crushed shadows, dull highlights
Subtle frame ghosting and imperfect image stabilization

Cinematic Lighting: Natural late-afternoon sunlight hits the wall diagonally, creating a strong division between light and shadow. The character falls within a narrow pocket of interesting light, while the surrounding street remains muted. The composition feels cinematic by accident, not through artificial dramatic lighting. Color Grade: Faded concrete greys, dusty beige, muted greens, dirty warm highlights, slightly cool shadows. Subtle nostalgic color separation, low saturation, imperfect white balance. Focus: The character remains recognizable but never perfectly sharp. Image degradation must affect the entire frame, including the character. Avoid the appearance of a perfectly rendered 3D character composited onto a blurry photographic background. Character Identity: Preserve the exact reference character's proportions, eye shape, silhouette, original materials, colors, and facial structure. Do not humanize, redesign, or add missing facial features or limbs. Final Aesthetic: A strangely beautiful, slightly unsettling, unintentionally cinematic moment captured through a terrible camera. Something that could become a viral internet image because the situation is so unusual, not because the photography is good. No HDR, no clean digital rendering, no professional photography sharpness, no glossy 3D appearance, no artificial cinematic effects. ar 16:9

entries.title: 16 张参考图合成的劫案电影海报
entries.note: 最多 16 张参考图，4K 2:3；需要按 @Image1~@Image16 配参考图。
entries.prompt:
Aspect ratio 2:3, 4K. Create an original cinematic heist movie poster using all 16 references. Characters @Image1 to @Image8 must keep their exact faces, hairstyles, body builds and outfits from their full-body references.

Prop mapping: @Image1 (the safecracker) holds the gold pocket watch from @Image11 open in his palm. @Image2 (the hacker) clutches the leather briefcase from @Image9 to his chest. @Image4 (the bodyguard) holds the revolver from @Image10 lowered at his side. @Image7 (the femme fatale) holds the carnival mask from @Image12 beside her face.

Setting: the 1940s train dining car from @Image13, at night, with rain streaking the windows and pink and cyan neon reflections as in @Image14. Apply the teal-and-amber colour grade, anamorphic flare and 35mm grain from @Image15.

Composition: @Image3 (the leader) stands front and centre, full figure, arms crossed. @Image5 (the con artist) leans on a table to her left, tipping his fedora. @Image6 (the getaway driver) sits on the table edge to her right, sunglasses on her head. @Image4 looms behind @Image3. @Image1, @Image2 and @Image7 are layered in depth down the aisle. @Image8 (the rookie) is in the far background, glancing nervously over his shoulder toward the camera.

Bottom third: the vintage ticket from @Image16 reworked into a haunting thriller title block. Keep its art deco border and perforated edge, but make it aged, scorched and torn at one corner, half sinking into deep black smoke and cold teal mist, with faint rain streaks across it and a thin trail of red light like a passing train's tail lamp. Small tagline above the ticket in thin, widely spaced capitals: "EIGHT PASSENGERS. ONE WAY OUT." On the ticket, the title "THE LAST TRAIN" in tall, condensed, distressed serif capitals with wide letter spacing, cold silver-white with a faint red inner glow, slightly cracked, and a thin horizontal light streak cutting through the letters like headlights in fog. Below the ticket, a classic Hollywood billing block: tiny, tightly packed, condensed sans-serif credits in muted grey, centred, three lines, starting with "A SYED ABUTHAHIR FILM" and followed by small cast and crew style lines. Under that, a small "ONLY IN THEATRES" line with tiny original fictional rating and studio marks. Spell "THE LAST TRAIN" and "A SYED ABUTHAHIR FILM" exactly as written. No real studio logos, no watermarks, no other names in the credits.

entries.note: 16:9 原生 4K 的产品拆解图；prompt 来自作者自己的回复。
entries.prompt: Aspect ratio 16:9, native 4K. Ultra-detailed premium technical exploded-view diagram of a Technics SL-1200 MK2 direct-drive DJ turntable, presented like a high-end engineering poster crossed with AAA product launch key art. The turntable is shown in a dramatic three-quarter isometric view from above, with every component separated vertically along a central axis and floating in correct assembly order, connected by thin glowing dashed alignment guides. From top to bottom: dust cover; felt slipmat; rubber platter mat; heavy die-cast aluminum platter with the four rows of strobe calibration dots machined around its rim; the direct-drive motor assembly exploded into rotor magnet ring, stator coil array with copper windings, and center spindle with bearing; the S-shaped tonearm assembly separated into headshell, cartridge and stylus, arm tube, pivot gimbal with bearings, counterweight, anti-skate dial, arm height adjustment ring, arm lift and arm rest; the silver die-cast aluminum top chassis with the rotary power switch and strobe illuminator, start/stop button, 33 and 45 speed buttons, the long pitch control fader marked +8 and -8, and the pop-up target light; the main circuit board with quartz lock components; the heavy damped rubber base; four adjustable insulator feet; plus the 45 RPM adapter, RCA cables and ground wire floating to the side. Each part labeled with thin white leader lines and small numbered callouts, with a clean parts legend panel on the right listing every numbered component. Top left title: "SL-1200 MK2 // DIRECT DRIVE EXPLODED VIEW". Bottom edge: a thin dimension line reading "453 x 353 x 162 mm". Setting: deep matte black background with a faint cyan engineering grid fading into darkness. Lighting: dramatic studio rim lighting, brushed aluminum and polished chrome with realistic anisotropic reflections, the strobe dots and target light glowing warm orange-red, subtle cyan accent glow on the guide lines, soft volumetric haze, tiny floating dust particles catching the light. Photoreal PBR materials, razor-sharp detail on every screw, spring, and wire, crisp legible correctly spelled text throughout. Cinematic, iconic, poster-worthy.

entries.author: bigyezi521
entries.title: 天气工厂：彩虹玻璃坊与造雪风车
entries.note: 两张图两段 prompt，16:9；原帖写“Grok Bot 自带图像生成”。
entries.prompt:
天气工厂 第二弹：彩虹是吹出来的，雪是磨出来的 🌈❄️
Weather Workshop, part 2: rainbows are blown like glass, snow is milled from clouds.

图1 彩虹玻璃坊：苏格兰高地山坡里的石头熔炉，工匠用铁杆把一道熔化的彩虹拉出炉口，彩虹边飞边冷却成透明玻璃，一路弯到远处的湖
图2 造雪风车：瑞士阿尔卑斯山脊上一座比松树还高的老木风车，风叶切进低云，把云磨成新雪，从滑槽倾泻到山下亮着灯的小镇

完整提示词（英文直接复制，16:9，Grok Bot 自带图像生成）：

1 Rainbow Forge:
Cinematic photoreal wide shot at golden hour in the Scottish Highlands: a giant stone glassblowing forge built into a mossy hillside, its furnace mouth glowing orange, and a team of tiny glassblowers in leather aprons pulling a molten rainbow out of the furnace on long iron rods, the rainbow cooling into solid translucent glass bands as it arcs across the misty valley toward a distant loch. Sheep and a small stone cottage below for scale, drifting rain mist, warm sparks, volumetric god rays, anamorphic lens flare, 35mm film grain, epic scale, no text.

2 Snow Mill:
Cinematic photoreal shot at blue hour high in the Swiss Alps: a colossal old wooden windmill, taller than the surrounding pine trees, standing on a snowy ridge, its enormous sails slicing through low clouds and grinding them into fresh snow that pours out of a chute in a glowing white cascade down the mountainside onto a sleeping alpine village with warm lit windows. A lone skier with a headlamp on the ridge for scale, swirling snow particles, moonlight rim light, 24mm wide lens, magical realism, film grain, no text.

小技巧：把「自然现象」写成「手工工序」（拉、吹、磨、织），画面会自动多出工匠、工具和故事感。

这一套还差一台机器：雷、雾还是龙卷风？评论区点单，下一弹就做票最多的 👇

entries.prompt:
